name: Is Level 5 drywall finishing significantly more expensive?
description: Yes, it's more expensive due to increased labor and materials for the full skim coat, but offers a superior aesthetic.

mainEntity.name: Is Level 5 drywall finishing significantly more expensive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Level 5 drywall finishing is typically more expensive than lower levels. This is due to the increased labor and material requirements. The additional step of applying a full skim coat over all surfaces, along with the subsequent sanding and inspection, requires skilled applicators and significantly more time. While the upfront cost is higher, the investment often pays off in the long run by providing a superior aesthetic that can enhance property value and prevent dissatisfaction with lower-quality finishes, especially in high-visibility areas or with demanding paint choices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it's more expensive due to increased labor and materials for the full skim coat, but offers a superior aesthetic.
